key_impacts: Coastal embankment overtopped and breached in six places
20.55 km of embankment damaged; villages inundated twice daily until 2013
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with a 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi, Aila killed 33 people and washed away 3,520 houses; 1,800 were partially damaged.
Storm surge overtopped and breached the embankment in six places, damaging 20.55 km.
